proverbs-21-20.text: The wise have wealth and luxury, but fools spend whatever they get.

luke-16-10.text: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much.

proverbs-13-11.text: Dishonest money dwindles away, but whoever gathers money little by little makes it grow.

proverbs-3-9.text: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops; then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.

deuteronomy-8-18.text: Remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.

matthew-6-33.text: Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you.

philippians-4-19.text: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

proverbs-22-7.text: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.

leviticus-27-30.text: A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the Lord; it is holy to the Lord.

deuteronomy-16-17.text: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the Lord your God has blessed you.

proverbs-11-24.text: One person gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty. A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

hebrews-13-16.text: And do not forget to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

2corinthians-8-12.text: For if the willingness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what one does not have.

matthew-6-3.text: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing, so that your giving may be in secret.

luke-6-38.text: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.
